task.title: P6-025: Runtime-verify three tree-move CSS and focus timing claims
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-025. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Three tree-move claims that need a runtime check rather than an argument** (line refs refreshed 2026-07-30 — the substance is unchanged and the check has still not been done): (a) the move dialog's `set_timeout(0)` re-focus (`tree_manage.rs:626`, was `:465`) is claimed to beat `hide_popover()` dropping focus to `<body>`, but it is timing-dependent — the e2e polls for `#tree-move-input`, so a loss shows up as *flake*, not as a red gate; (b) Tailwind emission order for `invisible` vs `md:visible` on the rail (`shell.rs:447`, was `:381`) is same-specificity and decided by generated source order — it matches the proven `hidden md:block` shape but the built CSS was never inspected; (c) the `⋯` button's `md:opacity-0` / `md:group-hover/row:opacity-100` / `md:focus-visible:opacity-100` interaction (`tree.rs:569`, was `:508`) is likewise source-order-dependent, and **`toBeVisible()` cannot catch a failure there** — opacity 0 reads as visible to Playwright — so nothing in the suite pins it.
